_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Times are seconds in the ORIGINAL recording.
_transcript_note: Word-level transcript: {"words":[{"word":"...","start":s,"end":s}, ...]} (e.g. OpenAI whisper-1, word timestamps).

voice._pitch_note: <1 deeper (anonymized). 0.80-0.86 = clear but natural for male voices.
voice._shift_rule_note: speaker_view = shift when the OTHER person is the on-screen tile >=0.8s; or 'intervals' to list manually.

face._method_note: branded_card = cover with logo + animated bullets when the other person is shown.

render._note: Optional. Omit to stop after the local/base cut and edit elsewhere.
